context: Shadowheart has at last come face‑to‑face with Nightsong, an immortal Selunite angel (the daughter of Selûne) who has been trapped in the Shadowfell for a century and is bitter, defiant, and full of rage. Shar has previously instructed Shadowheart to find the Spear of Night and use it to kill Nightsong so Shadowheart can become a Dark Justiciar; Shar urges the player to press the attack. If Shadowheart is a companion NPC she will always choose to kill Nightsong; if Shadowheart is the player’s Avatar, the player can instead choose to free her. Nightsong taunts and probes Shadowheart, even seeming to sense the spear and intimate wounds from Shadowheart’s past, making this confrontation as much about Shadowheart’s duty and identity as it is about the ritual.
